title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][review] Allow bounded SPP correction during implemented review remediation
body:
## Problem

Exact pre-PR review can find an actionable contradiction in SPP steps, invariants, or stop conditions after the issue reaches `implemented`, but typed `csdlc-edit` rejects `replace_plan_steps` and `replace_planning_collection` in that phase. This makes truthful review remediation impossible without forbidden direct card edits.

## Required fix

Permit bounded typed SPP plan-step, invariant, and stop-condition correction during `implemented` while an active claim exists. Preserve digest/generation/CAS checks, renderer/schema validation, audit recording, and exact-review invalidation. Add positive implemented-phase tests and retain rejection in later publication/merge phases.

## Acceptance

- `csdlc-edit` can correct SPP steps, invariants, and stop conditions during `implemented`.
- The mutation remains claim-, generation-, and digest-guarded and re-renders cards atomically.
- Reviewed/published/merge-ready phases remain fail-closed.
- Focused tests, format, strict Clippy, and exact review pass.
- PR body includes `Closes #<issue>`.
